exports.p13c_bounded_p_pop-B_lambda_arrays.npz: theta_boot_listener and theta_boot_twoway rebuild the replicate tables with p13c.layout_of(base, model.kept, the bounded terms of p13d.json's model), for P14's stable-reason rule
exports.p13c_bounded_p_pop-B_lambda_model.json: model.table_dict: the centered tables of each term (knots, heights, zero, missing) for P14

model.background: the level's p_pop negatives, full-fit weights
model.name: without both

protocol.model: p13d.json's model record (P13d's rules S1 and S2) at its level, arm and penalty weight
protocol.reference: R = mixture form A at the largest reference level

rules.A1: R is converged when the four fits at the largest reference level agree within TAU (largest gap of explanation points)
rules.A2: sampler bias per term and point: the model's configuration on the reference listeners minus R, flagged above TAU
rules.B1: near-optimal set: family members within SESOI of the family's best score. A member more than SESOI above the model, with the interval above 0, is flagged. The model does not change
rules.C1: bands: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles and SD over the replicates, sign share over the listener replicates, with importances
rules.D1: a reason is shown when it is a candidate, positive under the model, positive in at least 95% of the listener replicates and in the top 3 in at least 80%. The twoway replicates give a sensitivity run
